result.title: LongCat-Video-Avatar 1.6 Technical Report
result.summary: Recent advances in audio-driven avatar video generation have enabled increasingly realistic synthesis, yet achieving precise lip-audio synchronization, natural, human-like motion, and visual consistency over long sequences remains challenging. We present LongCat-Video-Avatar 1.6, which builds on LongCat-Video-Avatar 1.5 to improve expressive naturalness and reduce error accumulation during extended generation, e.g., exaggerated lip movements and overly red, temporally unstable lip coloration, enhance the naturalness of facial expressions and coordinated head and body movements. These improvements are driven by a refined post-training pipeline that integrates reinforcement learning, improved classifier-free guidance strategies for DMD-based few-step distillation, long-video rollouts, and on-policy distillation. Together, these refinements improve expressive realism and enable the generation of videos exceeding 10 minutes while maintaining visual quality and temporal consistency. Arena evaluations show that LongCat-Video-Avatar 1.6 outperforms its predecessor and competing commercial audio-driven avatar models, demonstrating the effectiveness of the improved post-training pipeline.

AI.brief_summary: 该报告介绍音频驱动虚拟人视频生成模型 LongCat-Video-Avatar 1.6，通过强化学习、改进 CFG 与 DMD 少步蒸馏、长视频 rollout 和 on-policy 蒸馏等后训练手段，提升长序列的唇音同步、表情与动作自然度及时间一致性。
AI.relevance_reason: 属于虚拟人视频生成与长视频稳定性工程，关注像素级生成质量和时间一致性，未涉及 VLM 推理状态、视觉证据使用或 latent 推理，缺乏可迁移的具体线索。
